profileEvidence.author: A
profileEvidence.summary: Affectionate with people, Argentine Polar Dogs ranged from quiet and docile to lively or combative within the pack. Trained teams pulled sledges over long Antarctic journeys, responding to voice commands and keeping a steady effort. Their strong, prolonged howls carried across the ice. This extinct working population was bred at Argentina’s Antarctic bases.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: Argentine Polar Dogs brought endurance and strong voices to sled work, with affectionate human bonds and varied pack temperaments.
